strategy: original109 regressions retained plus actual handler effect ordering/held async boundaries and strict validator cases; no provider/hosted/customer calls

cases.given: approval absent/empty/disabled/unapproved
cases.expected: 503 before reservation,decoder,source registration or provider; all effect counters zero

cases.given: malformed/oversized JSON,duplicates/unknown/missing keys,wrong version/purpose/types
cases.expected: same safe503; no configuration or customer data reflected

cases.given: whole approved JSON digest mismatched,or one region/retention/processor reference changed without repinning
cases.expected: same safe503 before effects; actual bytes/digest checked

cases.given: missing/invalid evidence refs or evidence SHA
cases.expected: same safe503; representations are required,not assumed from API key/consent

cases.given: future approved_at,expired/equal valid_until,invalid calendar or non-positive window
cases.expected: same safe503; exact boundaries checked with deterministic clock

cases.given: wrong processor or foreign/regional/redirect Responses endpoint
cases.expected: deny; minimum implementation supports only existing fixed global endpoint

cases.given: runtime model/org/project differs from approved tuple,or any required scope ID absent
cases.expected: deny before original bytes leave process

cases.given: runtime decoder URL/build differs from approved tuple,or decoder endpoint invalid under current restrictions
cases.expected: deny before decoder/provider; XLSX still follows its existing boundary

cases.given: caller supplies policy/approval/model/actor claims in request
cases.expected: current strict source schema rejects unexpected fields; never upgrades server authorization

cases.given: policy/config revoked or changed while real reserve RPC is held
cases.expected: upon resume deny before decoder; retain current failed reservation completion/charge,no refund

cases.given: policy expires/revokes/changes while real source registration ACK is held
cases.expected: after durable ACK deny before provider; existing safe unavailable source failure and failed budget outcome

cases.given: matching synthetic policy+hash/project/org/model/decoder/window,valid consent/source
cases.expected: one decoder and one provider attempt only; Auth,decoder verification,source ACK precede provider

cases.given: actual PDF/image outbound request under valid synthetic policy
cases.expected: original bytes/MIME/model/tool-free schema/store:false/max12000 unchanged; generic PDF filename; exact approved org/project headers only

cases.given: text/CSV/TXT with absent AI policy
cases.expected: original deterministic result and original source/preview binding unchanged; no decoder/provider

cases.given: XLSX with absent AI policy
cases.expected: current actual HMAC decoder/independent TSV comparison and strict result unchanged; no OpenAI

cases.given: same approved policy completed exact request replay
cases.expected: identical immutable preview; no second decoder/provider/completion attempt

cases.given: same policy failed saved replay or in-progress/crashed lease
cases.expected: original safe failed409/502 behavior; no reacquisition/retry/refund or new source failure overwrite

cases.given: completed AI upload replay after policy revoked/expired under recommended preflight
cases.expected: safe503 with no RPC/decoder/provider; old immutable rows remain; separately test existing guarded recovery read if scope assigned

cases.given: policy/config model changed for old upload lineage
cases.expected: no relabelling/re-extraction; existing request conflict/receipt validation retains old lineage

cases.given: Auth failure/SID mismatch/source consent failure/oversized body
cases.expected: existing Auth/input error before policy-dependent transmission; effects remain blocked

cases.given: valid policy but invalid signed decoder,denied/forged source ACK or lost ACK
cases.expected: existing safe errors,source custody/budget semantics and zero provider attempts remain

cases.given: provider HTTP failure/network/timeout/refusal/oversize/duplicate output
cases.expected: existing bounded sanitized error; ambiguous lease/full charge,no automatic retry and no raw response persistence

cases.given: missing provider key under otherwise valid policy
cases.expected: preserve existing unavailable source-attempt behavior/no provider; do not silently weaken its existing assertion

baseline_failure_proof: Before applying future guard,run new approval-denial tests against exact old production source and preserve expected failures; avoid calling old109 proof policy acceptance.
required_after_future_authorization: actual maintained codec fixture if its config signature changes
affected readiness/delivery synthetic tests only if those sources are separately assigned
